name: Dombois (2001): Petrinja 2020 at MORC (near, about 4.4°)
description: The Mw 6.4 Petrinja (Croatia) earthquake of 2020-12-29 11:19:55 UTC, about 4.4° from GEOFON station MORC: 10 minutes of the vertical component from 11:19:25 UTC, audified 2,200 times faster as Dombois (2001) did, so a near quake sounds as a short sharp event. Data: GEOFON Seismic Network (GFZ), doi:10.14470/TR560404, CC BY 4.0. Replication gallery, C03-T06.
